## [2.41.0] — 2026-07-20

### Added

- **slice-story:** derive story.html's signoff panel from the deterministic trust ledger (gate_log reality_contact) instead of the narrator-authored signoff, so a model cannot render a model-only pass as reality-proven (slice-086-ground-slice-story-signoff-in-trust-ledger) [ADR-102]
- **gate-log:** shard the gate-log behind a record-level storage seam (slice-088-shard-gate-log-behind-storage-seam) [ADR-105, ADR-106]
- **gate-log:** migrate the five gate-log direct readers to derive-on-missing so a synced/cloned vault reads real rows instead of silently reading zero (slice-089-migrate-gate-log-readers-to-derive-on-missing) [ADR-107]
- **claim:** make candidate claiming safe on a shared remote vault so two concurrent picks can never both build the same slice (slice-091-make-shared-vault-claim-safe) [ADR-110, ADR-111, ADR-112, ADR-113]
- **vault-sync:** add a vault_admin sync push|pull verb for the git backend so a vault can be pushed to / pulled from a git remote and a fresh clone reconstructs it via derive-on-missing (slice-092-add-vault-git-sync-verb) [ADR-114]
- **vault-sync:** Add an S3/MinIO storage backend to vault_admin sync push|pull so a vault can be synced across machines over an S3-compatible object store, not only a git remote. (slice-095-add-s3-minio-vault-sync-backend) [ADR-119]
- **claim:** Add an in-lock, logged, append-only ownership TRANSFER verb to claim_candidate.py so a claimed slice can be reassigned to another developer without the standing AI_SDLC_ALLOW_FOREIGN_SLICE suppression ADR-068 warns against. (slice-096-add-claim-ownership-transfer-verb) [ADR-120, ADR-122]
- **setup:** Wire the /setup UX for SC-197: a vault base-location step + a local|git|s3 backend picker that configures (never runs) vault_admin sync push|pull (slice-097-add-setup-vault-backend-picker) [ADR-121, ADR-123]
- **candidates:** Give a slice candidate its own `area` field, written through a mediated seam, so a candidate that is NOT product-scope-sourced can carry a product-area and be filtered by the `/slice --area` lens. (slice-098-add-first-class-candidate-area-field) [ADR-124, ADR-125]
- **claim:** add a git-backed claim backend for shared, git-synced vaults (slice-100-add-git-backed-claim-backend) [ADR-129, ADR-130, ADR-131, ADR-132, ADR-133]
- **slice:** Make /slice pick for APP COMPLETION rather than for score rank. (slice-102-add-completion-gap-gate-to-slice) [ADR-140, ADR-141, ADR-142, ADR-143, ADR-144, ADR-145, ADR-146, ADR-147, ADR-148, ADR-149, ADR-150, ADR-151, ADR-152, ADR-153]

### Changed

- rename the Product-shape output template's "component" to "area"
- refresh product docs for vault sync, claim coordination + the area/completion levers

### Fixed

- **gate-log:** close the shard create-then-write window that let a lock-free reader observe a partial 0-byte <seq>.json (false corruption) (slice-090-close-shard-write-reader-race-window) [ADR-109, ADR-108]
- **product-scope:** Complete write-seam mediation of the product-scope item contract, closing two same-family bypasses (SC-185 area-parity + SC-170 assumptions-strip). (slice-093-harden-product-scope-write-mediation) [ADR-118]
- **validate-slice:** run the forked /validate-slice shippability catalog synchronously so validation.json is never orphaned (slice-094-fix-validate-slice-fork-catalog-orphan) [ADR-116, ADR-117]
- **reflect:** make the canonical calibration key true in prose and enforced by the lint (slice-101-fix-reflect-calibration-key-prose-drift) [ADR-134, ADR-135, ADR-136, ADR-137, ADR-138, ADR-139]

- **build-checks:** reject a malformed build-check rule at mint (vault_edit) and make the BC-1 audit fail loud rather than silently drop it (slice-071-lint-build-check-rules-at-mint) [ADR-075]
- **product-scope:** Repair the `product_scope.py revise` contract, which had two defects at the SAME boundary: a delta-shaped payload silently DELETED every omitted item from the product's scope of record at exit 0 (SC-160), and one proven assumption froze the scope permanently (SC-161). (slice-073-fix-product-scope-revise-contract) [ADR-078, ADR-079, ADR-080]

- **product-scope:** enforce completeness of the two product-scope contract fields (verification_plan, user_visible_outcome) at the single _check_contract recognizer (slice-076-enforce-product-item-contract-completeness) [ADR-087]
- **product-scope:** Extend product_scope.py's source taxonomy so `discover` and `slice-NNN-abandoned` source refs classify as EXHAUST, so the real-vault census reports UNCLASSIFIED == 0 instead of 3 rows outside the taxonomy. (slice-079-close-candidate-source-taxonomy-gap) [ADR-090]
- **product-scope:** harden two product-scope input seams against malformed/reserved input (SC-182 write seam + SC-181 read seam, folded) (slice-083-harden-product-scope-seam-guards) [ADR-095, ADR-096]
- restore product_shape in the story-sections example schema (areas) to unblock build-consistency

## [2.37.0] — 2026-06-19

### Added

- **slice:** Close the /slice selection->claim window via a two-phase reserve-on-pick claim (slice-027-reserve-candidate-on-pick) [ADR-016]

- **design-tournament:** surface the design tournament's full per-designer detail with an honest expert-source check (slice-039-surface-design-tournament-detail) [ADR-026]
- **product-doc:** verify the product-doc public_surface deterministically against code reality (slice-040-verify-product-doc-public-surface-deterministically) [ADR-028]
- **critique:** thread the active worktree path + ADR-012 repro note into /critique Step-2 Critic prompt (slice-042-thread-worktree-ctx-into-critic-prompt) [ADR-029]
- **user-test:** Add an opt-in forked-sonnet novice pre-flight to /user-test that pre-drafts observation questions as a weaker model-only screen, never real-user validation. (slice-044-add-user-test-preflight-sim-agent) [ADR-034]
- **review:** Lint agent-authored artifacts at the write boundary (source inspection) (slice-045-add-artifact-lint-to-code-review) [ADR-032, ADR-033]
- **test-first:** Close the producer/gate gap for the test_first slice discipline — auto-scaffold the test_first_plan PENDING stub at /slice. (slice-051-harmonize-test-first-plan-producer-and-gate) [ADR-041, ADR-042]
- **gate-log:** populate findings_real/findings_noise on the critique-review (DR-1) gate-log row so its precision/recall is measurable (slice-052-log-critique-review-catches-to-gate-log) [ADR-045]
- **commit-slice:** Add an informed local branch force-delete so /commit-slice local cleanup finishes deleting a squash-merged slice branch, gated fail-closed on the authoritative gh PR MERGED verdict. (slice-057-add-gh-gated-branch-force-cleanup) [ADR-054]
- **commit-slice:** Pre-merge integration-health gate: re-run the full shippability catalog against the post-rebase uat tip and refuse the merge on red. (slice-059-add-integration-health-merge-gate) [ADR-056]
- **reality-gate:** add a pluggable reality-gate slot -- projects declare deterministic gates the pre-finish and validate gates run fail-closed (slice-062-add-pluggable-reality-gate-slot) [ADR-059]
- **recall:** Replace reflection_lookup's brittle >=2-exact-keyword binary recall matcher with a graded TF-IDF cosine relevance ranking behind a pluggable-scorer seam (slice-063-add-semantic-reflection-recall) [ADR-060]
- slice-031 -- thread the explicit slice-arg into the analytical loop skills
- consented commit of ai-sdlc config (reality-gates.json + .gitignore)

### Changed

- **slice-resolution:** reconcile the terminal-stage definition across the 3 resolvers into one shared source of truth (slice-037-reconcile-terminal-stages-across-resolvers) [ADR-024]
- **test-first:** Make the test_first slice-discipline handoff explicit so the required test_first_plan[] never surfaces as a surprise pre-finish gate FAIL. (slice-038-make-test-first-plan-handoff-explicit)
- **slice-story:** consolidate /slice-story's two HTML outputs (story.html + tournament.html) into one combined report (slice-043-consolidate-slice-story-html) [ADR-030]
- **verification:** Unify the two divergent verification executors behind one shared fail-closed execution core and close the WS-1 silent-pass gap (slice-047-unify-ws1-execute-with-shippability-runner-core) [ADR-038]
- **grounding-verify:** batch all crg: grounding tokens into ONE probe invocation (N+1 over tokens -> 1) (slice-053-optimize-grounding-verify-batch-probe) [ADR-046]
- **release:** rename the /product-doc command to /release for discoverability (slice-060-rename-product-doc-skill-to-release) [ADR-057]
- **integration-branch:** namespace the pipeline's integration branch uat -> aisdlc-uat so it cannot collide with a host project's own uat (slice-061-rename-integration-branch-to-aisdlc-uat) [ADR-058]
- **validate-slice:** run mergeable shippability catalog rows in one pytest session (fixtures boot once, bounded, below-normal priority) (slice-064-speed-up-shippability-catalog-runner) [ADR-061]
- release 2.37.0: merge uat -> master + bump + changelog
- added token saving instructions
- fix Step-4 ADR-seal false-STOP + doc nits (design-slice review)

### Fixed

- **build-slice:** optional-file injection no longer aborts /build-slice on a skipped critique (slice-024-fix-build-slice-critique-json-injection-aborts-on-skip)
- **diff-base:** anchor the slice diff base on the LOCAL integration branch, never origin/HEAD (slice-025-fix-slice-diff-base-origin-lag)
- **skills:** make SKILL.md temp paths Windows-portable (slice-026-fix-skill-tmp-paths-windows-portability)
- **slice-index:** Reconcile the slice index writers + live data onto the canonical schema-by-example via a deterministic regenerator. (slice-030-reconcile-slice-index-schema) [ADR-020]
- **shippability:** distinguish absent-on-checkout tests from real regressions in the shippability gate (slice-033-fix-shippability-absent-test-rows) [ADR-021]
- **slice-resolution:** move active-slice resolution from !-injection to bash BODY step (slice-034-move-explicit-slice-resolution-from-injection-to-body) [ADR-022]
- **id-allocation:** count distinct slice entities in the counters audit so a slice seen via multiple sources is not a false duplicate (slice-041-fix-counters-audit-slice-double-count) [ADR-027]
- **shippability:** Fix TOOL-3: SCMD-1 rejects a non-portable bare-pytest machine_cmd via a shared interpreter-anchored validator (slice-046-harden-runnable-command-gates) [ADR-035]
- **build-slice:** Fix the BC-1 Critical-ack forwarding bug: pre_finish_gate forwarded --ack-critical as a single un-split token. (slice-048-fix-pre-finish-gate-multi-critical-ack) [ADR-036]
- **validate-slice:** Teach VAL-1 Layer B to resolve the project's own internal imports so it stops false-flagging them as hallucinated dependencies. (slice-049-improve-val1-layerb-resolve-internal-imports) [ADR-039, ADR-044]
- **vault-edit:** Harden vault_edit append against accidental double-application on the --stdin read path (SC-041). (slice-050-fix-vault-edit-append-stdin-double-apply) [ADR-040, ADR-043]
- **commit-slice:** harden /commit-slice --sync-after-pr for repos where GitHub head-branch auto-delete is OFF (slice-054-fix-sync-after-pr-auto-delete-off) [ADR-047, ADR-048, ADR-051, ADR-052, ADR-053]
- **adr-audit:** Close the ADR-append-only gate's deletion blind spot: a SEALED ADR removed from disk was returning exit 0 'clean'. (slice-055-detect-sealed-adr-deletion) [ADR-049]
- **code-review:** /code-review review-diff silently excluded branch-only top-level files because bash pre-expanded the unquoted $paths glob against the main tree (slice-056-fix-code-review-diff-pathspec-tests-glob) [ADR-050]
- **vault:** Stop the vault from silently orphaning when git init re-keys its hash (SC-107). (slice-058-gate-git-before-vault-creation-and-auto-pin) [ADR-055]
- resolve vault per-invocation instead of inline-reading the de-leaked AI_SDLC_VAULT_ROOT
- sync doc-manifest.json example to aggregate.py output
- resolve 3 CI failures introduced by slices 040-042
- pipeline review sweep -- fix all 30 per-skill review findings
